a.lede: After a shocking downfall, Nvidia’s CEO is out of a job. WIRED’s Lauren Goode explains what that means for the world’s most critical chip company, the AI industry, and Jensen Huang himself.
a.title: Jensen Huang Is Gone. Now What?

b.lede: Despite Nvidia's board saying it has no intention of bringing former CEO Jensen Huang back to the company, some directors are reportedly still pushing for that to happen.
b.title: Nvidia board faction angling for Jensen Huang return as CEO, report claims
